subject: environmental-science

moments.title: IUCN founded
moments.who: International Union for Conservation of Nature
moments.body: Founded in Fontainebleau, IUCN compiles the Red List of Threatened Species from 1964 onwards.
moments.takeaway: Conservation governance began as an inter-state and NGO initiative.

moments.title: Convention on Biological Diversity
moments.body: The Convention on Biological Diversity opens for signature, committing parties to biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and equitable benefit-sharing.
moments.takeaway: Biodiversity and climate frameworks emerged from the same political moment.

moments.title: Global Biodiversity Framework
moments.body: Parties agree to protect 30% of land and sea by 2030 ('30x30').
moments.takeaway: Quantitative biodiversity targets joined climate-style numerical pledges.

now.title: Biodiversity today
now.body: Living Planet Index and IUCN Red List both indicate continuing declines. Major drivers include land-use change, climate change, pollution and invasive species.
now.open_questions: How can biodiversity finance scale to delivery? What metrics best track ecosystem function rather than species counts alone?

reflection: Biodiversity policy has historically received less attention than climate; the two are increasingly treated as joined problems.
